title: The sequencing atlas's references
set_out: Read the library floor on the 137 healthy sequenced samples; build the held-error reference from the 153 healthy inputs; find why the megakaryocyte column does not name donor 3; keep the B and T commissioning samples aligning.
open_at_turnover: Running on GitHub's machines: the library floor on the 137 healthy sequenced samples and the B and T commissioning samples. The held-error reference is built and in the chain.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The megakaryocyte donors read against each other
entries.what: The three megakaryocyte donors compared pairwise, and each with a monocyte and a lung macrophage input, by a new pair comparison tested on a known answer first.
entries.outcome: The donors agree with each other more than with the cells donor 3 was named as. The comparison's depth-weighted score had a fault (it averaged a ratio at each site) and was corrected; read again with it, donor 3 reads nearest megakaryocytes (development, on a spent donor; the committed test stays not met).

entries.title: Each healthy cell's held error, region by region
entries.what: The 153 healthy sequenced inputs' molecules counted on Google spot machines, pooled by cell into 14,133 regions beside the sequencing atlas.
entries.outcome: Built and in the chain: 56 cells. It is the reference IAM-A needs to read plasma once the Deconvolver has found what is in it.
